full_prompt_en: A square muted oil painting shows three young women standing close together against a worn cream and gray interior wall. The background is almost empty, but thin vertical scrapes, patches of dark underpainting, and pale brushed areas make the wall visibly uneven. The three figures fill the center from about the knees upward, leaving a little open space around their shoulders and head silhouettes. On the left, a dark-haired woman in a white short-sleeved blouse and dark skirt turns slightly toward the others while looking directly at the viewer. Narrow dark shoulder straps cross her pale blouse. In the middle, a fair-haired woman faces forward in an ocher-brown collared top tied at the neck and a long cream apron or skirt. Her light face and pale lower garment create the brightest vertical passage in the group. On the right, another dark-haired woman stands nearest the foreground in a rust-red blouse with a white collar and dark high-waisted skirt. Her body angles inward, but her face meets the viewer with the same quiet, guarded seriousness. Their arms hang low, and their shoulders overlap enough to make them read as a single compact mass. The clothing is painted with broad matte folds and restrained detail, while the faces receive smoother modeling around eyes, cheeks, and mouths. A broad patch of light from the upper left brings out their features and pale garments; the right side of the wall and the lower skirts fade into heavier brown-gray shadow. There is no readable text or specific furnishing. The overall composition is still and frontal, using three closely spaced silhouettes, earthy workwear colors, and unfinished-looking wall texture to create a restrained psychological presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形低饱和油画呈现三位年轻女子紧靠着站在磨旧的乳白与灰色室内墙前。背景几乎空无一物，但细长竖向刮痕、深色底层颜料斑块和浅色刷痕让墙面明显不平整。三个人物占满中央，从约膝部向上入画，肩膀与头部剪影周围仍留少量空处。左侧深发女子穿白色短袖衬衫和深裙，身体略向另外两人转去，同时直视观者。窄深色肩带越过她的浅色衬衣。中间的浅发女子正面站立，穿赭棕色翻领上衣，领口系结，下身是长长的乳白色围裙或裙子。浅色面庞与浅色下装形成这一组里最亮的竖向通道。右侧另一位深发女子离前景最近，穿锈红上衣、白领和深色高腰裙。身体朝内倾，但面孔以同样安静而戒备的严肃神情迎向观者。三人的手臂自然垂下，肩膀彼此重叠，使她们读作紧凑的一个整体。衣服以宽阔的哑光褶皱和克制细节绘成，面庞的眼睛、脸颊和嘴部则得到较平滑的塑形。来自左上方的大片光照出五官和浅色衣物；右侧墙面及下方裙摆渐入较沉的棕灰阴影。没有可读文字或具体家具。整体构图静止且正面，以三道紧贴的剪影、泥土色工作服装和看似未完成的墙面肌理建立克制的心理存在感。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting holds clearly modeled focal forms inside a deliberately spare, abraded ground. Cream, ocher, rust, muted gray, and deep brown form a low-saturation palette with little decorative color. Smoothly turned light planes receive attention near the center, while broad matte brush passes simplify the surrounding shapes. Thin scuffs, exposed underpainting, and vertical streaks make the background feel physically worked instead of cleanly finished. Silhouettes are firm where a light form meets a dark one, then soften where adjacent values approach each other. Gentle directional light gives rounded volume without theatrical highlights; shadow is broad and earthy. Several close vertical forms overlap into one compact group, leaving enough pale wall around them to prevent crowding. The overall effect is solemn, intimate, and psychologically charged, with restrained color and painterly incompletion sharpening the sense of presence.
style_prompt_zh: 这种油画把清楚塑形的焦点形体安置在刻意简省且受磨损的背景里。乳白、赭黄、锈红、低饱和灰和深棕组成低饱和配色，几乎没有装饰性色彩。中央附近转折平滑的受光色面获得注意力，周围形状则由宽阔哑光刷笔简化。细小擦痕、露出的底层颜料和竖向流纹让背景显得经过实体加工，而非整洁收尾。浅形接深形时剪影坚实，相近明度相接时则变柔。温和定向光给予圆润体积，没有戏剧性高光；阴影宽阔而带泥土色。数道靠近的竖向形体重叠成紧凑的一组，周围留有足够浅色区域，避免过分拥挤。整体效果庄重、亲密且富心理张力，克制色彩和绘画上的未完成感强化了存在感。
theme_en: Three solemn young women standing together against a worn pale wall
theme_zh: 三位神情严肃的年轻女子并肩站在斑驳浅色墙前
name: Michael Borremans
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
